study type: Mixed-methods evaluation (pre-post intervention study with survey and audit data)
exposure: Physiological breech birth one-day training program
outcome: Clinician confidence in managing breech births
Maternal birth positions (use of upright birthing positions)
cohort: The study included 263 clinicians who completed surveys and audit data from 1402 women undergoing singleton vaginal breech births at term in eight National Health Service hospitals.
finding: The one-day physiological breech birth training program significantly increased clinician confidence and knowledge and led to a significant increase in the use of upright birthing positions for singleton vaginal breech births at term, though overall vaginal birth rates remained similar.
mod_finding: Overall vaginal birth rates for singleton vaginal breech births at term remained similar in the period after the training program compared to before.
